stemMarkdown: The average of 24 observations was calculated as 47, but one observation was wrongly read as 52 instead of the correct value 78. What is the correct average? (Round to 2 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: The recorded total was $24 \times 47 = 1128$. Correcting the single entry changes it by $78 - 52 = 26$, giving a true total of $1154$. The correct average is $\dfrac{1154}{24} = 48.08$.
